description: Purchases one or more new mobile proxies and adds them to the account. Charges the balance IMMEDIATELY — REQUIRES explicit user confirmation. Always call get_balance + get_price first, and ideally do a dry-run with estimate_only=true to see the final amount. country accepts ISO code or numeric id_country; for geo-precise orders pass geoid from get_geo_list. period_days must be one of 1,3,7,14,30,60,90,180,365. Returns the new proxies with full connection details on success.

count.description: How many proxies to buy (max 50 in one call)

country.description: Target country as 2-letter ISO code (or use id_country / geoid)

estimate_only.description: Dry-run: returns the total amount without charging or allocating

period_days.description: Proxy duration in days; one of 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365

name: buy_proxy
title: Purchase a new mobile proxy
